response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    insurance_status,
    avg_remaining_storage,
    avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference,
    avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER (), 0) AS storage_ratio
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference,
  storage_ratio
FROM scored
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) FROM group_averages) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is each group's average remaining storage divided by the unweighted mean of the non-NULL group averages; groups with no non-NULL remaining-storage values remain in the results with a NULL ratio when that overall mean exists.
